### Godliness
Author: Pastor Chuck Swindoll
Site: Insight for Living
URL: https://insight.org/resources/daily-devotional/individual/godliness1
Passage: 2 Corinthians 7:1
Points:
- Superficial Christianity cannot withstand the corrupting pressure of worldly standards.
- Pursuing a consistent, godly walk is an act of spiritual worship pleasing to God.
- Believers must actively allow God to renew and transform their thinking each day.
- Standing alone for righteousness requires courage when surrounded by cultural compromise.

### Repentance
Author: Oswald Chambers
Site: My Utmost for His Highest
URL: https://utmost.org/updated/repentance/
Passage: 2 Corinthians 7:10
Points:
- Conviction of sin focuses our conscience primarily on our accountability before God.
- Godly sorrow leads to genuine confession rather than mere self-disgust over personal failure.
- Lasting transformation and holiness demonstrate that a person has truly received forgiveness.
- Genuine biblical repentance is a gracious gift from God rather than human self-reformation.
- Maintaining a sensitive, repentant spirit keeps believers from growing hardened in sin.
